audit.why: 48.74% over 954 games with the page at EVEN, difficulty 6/10, Kled carry threat 7/10. Mounted Kled wins the opening levels; Sett takes over once Facebreaker and Haymaker can force the dismount. The mirror kept the same shape, only re-siding the first two rows.
audit.corrected: EVEN lane: his level 1, your levels 3 onward, decided by who forces the dismount.

audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers gave Sett levels 1 and 2 and then handed levels 4-5, first item and two-plus items to 'Skill'. The packet chart and the mirror both give level 1 to Kled and level 2 to neither, and every content why from whys[3] on says Sett is ahead — the tokens disagreed with the page's own prose. whys[1] also claimed Facebreaker at level 2; it unlocks at 3.
audit.why: Mirror: 'Row 0 -> Kled, row 1 -> Skill, rows 2 and 4 stay Sett.' Packet gives Sett rows 3, 5 and 6, which is what whys[3], whys[5] and whys[6] already argue.
audit.corrected: Chart set to Kled / Skill / Sett / Sett / Sett / Sett / Sett in both layers, ratings re-scaled, phases[0] and phases[1] whys rewritten to their new owners, and the level-2 Facebreaker error removed.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns and dosFull[0] said only 'his engage hook, dodge it' — no cooldown, no range. Chaaaaaaaarge!!! was described purely as an engage, with no mention that it arrives with a shield that eats the burst window Sett is committing.
audit.why: Bear Trap on a Rope is 11s at rank 1 with 800 range and yanks the target in after the shackle. Violent Tendencies is 13s at rank 1 and gives four fast attacks — that wind-up, not a cast, is the burst tell. Chaaaaaaaarge!!! is 140s at rank 1 and grants a shield on arrival, so a Haymaker cashed into it is wasted.
audit.corrected: Bear Trap: 11s, 800 range — dodging it removes his engage for 11 seconds. Violent Tendencies: 13s, four fast attacks. Chaaaaaaaarge!!!: 140s at rank 1, arrives with a shield — force it out before you cash grit.

edits.before: Double-punch passive makes you the strongest level-1 auto-trader in the lane. Punish Kled on every CS, but respect his opening tool — chips now, all-ins later.
edits.after: Mounted Kled owns level 1 — Bear Trap yanks you in on an 11s cooldown and Violent Tendencies gives him four fast attacks. Soak the wave and contest nothing.

edits.before: Q gives move speed toward Kled and two empowered punches. Take short Q trades and back off before he can answer with Bear Trap on a Rope.
edits.after: Level 2 evens out: Knuckle Down's two punches and move speed match his W burst, but you have no stick until Facebreaker at 3. Keep trades short.

edits.before: - Kled Bear Trap on a Rope: matchup-defining — His engage hook. Dodge it. Track it before every engage.
edits.after: - Bear Trap on a Rope (Q): 11s at rank 1, 800 range — dodge it and his engage is gone for 11 seconds.

edits.before: His engage hook. Dodge it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: His hook, 11s at rank 1 and 800 range — sidestep it, then step up.

edits.before: Sett takes L2 once E Facebreaker lets him stick and trade back.
edits.after: L2 is even — Knuckle Down trades back into his 13s W burst.

edits.before: Your R The Show Stopper answers his R Chaaaaaa... charge engage — save it to peel his dive or to all-in after he uses W Violent Tendencies, and the fight is yours since he can't kite your slow.
edits.after: Chaaaaaaaarge!!! is 140s at rank 1 and arrives with a shield, so force it out before you cash grit — a Haymaker into that shield is wasted. All-in once his four Violent Tendencies attacks are spent.
